vulnerability_summary: Shakapacker exposed the complete build environment through webpack/rspack EnvironmentPlugin defaults.
causality: The advisory explicitly dates the webpack vulnerability to the original Webpacker implementation and says no recent change triggered it. Human commit e35925b8 installed EnvironmentPlugin with every process.env key in 2017, and human commit 9043e1b7 simplified that same all-environment behavior to EnvironmentPlugin(process.env) in 2020. For the later Rspack path, human atomic commit a7188041 created package/plugins/rspack.js with new rspack.EnvironmentPlugin(process.env). Claude-coauthored atomic commit 7dd51d55 only reformatted entrypoint filters in that file; it left the vulnerable EnvironmentPlugin line unchanged. The squash 591e3de9 carries the PR tree but does not transfer causal authorship from the human atomic origin. Fix 3e06781b replaced both vulnerable calls with getFilteredEnv().
